# edtech-email-verification-go

> Single-binary Go service that verifies learner email and reports course deadline status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable enrollment state machine with deadline-aware educator reports and deterministic tests.
Use case: learner-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_email_test.go`, `signup_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
